steps:
Reference cohort mass
M = m × N × 1000 g/kg

Substitution: 2.125000e-5 kg × 1000 kernels × 1000 g/kg

Result: 21.250000 g

The marker represents 1000 independent identical kernels, not a physical clump.

Relative air speed
Vr = √[(u − vx)² + (−vy)²]

Substitution: √[(3 − 0.244832)² + (1.879293)²]

Result: 3.335070 m/s

Drag uses the full relative vector; vertical and horizontal squared speeds are not treated as separate drag laws.

Quadratic drag magnitude
D = ½ρCdA Vr²

Substitution: 0.5 × 1.2 kg/m³ × 0.720000 × 6.800000e-6 m² × (3.335070 m/s)²

Result: 3.267402e-5 N

Drag components Fx=2.699266e-5 N, Fy=1.841162e-5 N. Direction opposes particle motion relative to air.

Current horizontal acceleration
ax = Fx / m

Substitution: 2.699266e-5 N / 2.125000e-5 kg

Result: 1.270243 m/s²

Uniform prescribed wind supplies energy to the drifting kernel.

Current vertical acceleration
ay = Fy / m − g

Substitution: 1.841162e-5 N / 2.125000e-5 kg − 9.81 m/s²

Result: -8.943571 m/s²

Positive y is upward; gravity acts downward.

Kernel weight
W = m g

Substitution: 2.125000e-5 kg × 9.81 m/s²

Result: 0.000208 N

This is the weight of one reference kernel; cohort mass accounting is separate.

Limiting speed in still air
vt = √[2mg / (ρCdA)]

Substitution: √[2 × 2.125000e-5 kg × 9.81 m/s² / (1.2 kg/m³ × 0.720000 × 6.800000e-6 m²)]

Result: 8.423986 m/s

A hypothetical constant-drag still-air limit, not necessarily reached within this drop height. It is not horizontal wind speed or measured crop data.

Predicted landing position
Integrate dx/dt=vx, dy/dt=vy, dv/dt=F/m until y=0

Substitution: RK4 at Δt=0.0025 s; u=3 m/s; release height=1.2 m

Result: 0.370818 m

Predicted flight duration 0.516149 s. A prediction may be shown before that cohort is released; it is not a recorded arrival.

Near-mat rice purity
Purity = 100 × near rice / (near rice + near husk)

Substitution: 100 × 0.000000 g / (0.000000 g + 0.000000 g)

Result: Undefined · empty collected fraction

No material is on the near mat: 0/0 is undefined, never 100% purity.

Overall rice recovery
Recovery = 100 × near rice / initial rice

Substitution: 100 × 0.000000 g / 600.000000 g

Result: 0.000000 %

Provisional: the denominator includes the whole initial rice mass, including material still in the source or air.

Complete material balance
M = source + airborne + near + far + outside

Substitution: 626.750000 g + 21.250000 g + 0.000000 g + 0.000000 g + 0.000000 g

Result: 648.000000 g

Initial material=600.000000 g rice + 48.000000 g husk. Outside-floor material is retained, not deleted.
